notes.title: Summer update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33519861/2dfcb87c878341d75002dd7b8f542cd67d3491d5.png

Ladies and gentlemen, visitors of MatchVille!
In new 0.9 version you’ll find:
- Out game is now available on Google Play all around the world.
- Updated game environment details.
- Game performance is improved. 

Hurry up and catch the wave of summer update!

notes.title: New update - new life chapter of Matchville!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33519861/60bf6ca63822b661269f66f90cdc70e25f832359.png

In 0.8.5 version you will find: 
- Max and Alice arrange new event. Help them make it incredible! 
- Now you can view the content of lootboxes in game inventory. 
- Awards for daily quests with no delays! 

Download a new update! Find out the history of the previous cafe owner!

notes.title: Spring is in Matchville
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33519861/7f4627b2d7badc0a2a499e7225b02c6bc508b238.png

Everyone who is looking forward to warm days, we have a bright update for you:

1. A fascinating event every weekend. Be in time to grow a wonderful tree. 
2. New story: what will Max find in an ancient casket?
3. The balance of levels is changed. 
4. We’ve improved the interface for opening Lootboxes.

Hurry up! Matchville always welcomes you back.

notes.title: Update 0.8.3
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33519861/48666b4735e2e9c988a88b4981b4237117ae5d8a.png

All the lovers of sweet news! Here are the changes you will find in the new version of Matchville:

1. New everyday tasks.
2. The story continues. Help Max set up a party for a new guest.
3. The balance of levels is changed.
4. Now the game loads even faster.
Enjoy the game. And hurry up, cafe visitors are waiting for you!

notes.title: New sweet update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33519861/a1353e0356531b0079fc1f2c30a5427aaae3984e.png

Friends, take a look on this list of changes in v.0.8.2:
1. Now on Android! We launched Matchville in early access on Google Play.
2. The number of prizes in a competitive event is increased. Now it's 15! The content of the awards is also changed. 
3. We added new mascots.

Hurry up and try out the updated version of the game!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33519861/d7eaf3b900333bad3c2860a72a1c3b15695c24a6.png

Check out this steaming hot change list for v0.8.1

1. Competition events added
2. A mailbox for you to get easier access to messages from developers
3. Reduced loading time between scenes
4. Levels rebalanced
5. Availability to skip in-game videos (cut-scenes)
6. New animations
7. Updated sounds

Let the update start over with a clean slate!
